title: An ensemble of graph generative models for assisted history matching of the Brugge field case
abstract: arXiv:2611.12927v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Assisted history matching remains non-unique because many geological realisations can reproduce equivalent production responses with substantial differences between individual well matches. This ambiguity increases when a field comprises several depositional settings and modelling strategies. The paper applied a graph autoencoder approach to history matching of a benchmark Brugge field that comprises different depositional zones. Each stratigraphic zone is modelled with its dedicated generative model that comprises a joint latent space for optimisation history matching loops. Graph-based generators operate directly on the active cells of the corner-point grid, so its irregular geometry is handled without conversion to a regular lattice. The optimisation search in the 160-dimensional joint latent space is done with the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy. translated_title: 用于Brugge油田辅助历史拟合的图生成模型集成方法
translated_abstract: 辅助历史拟合仍然存在非唯一性问题，因为许多地质实现能够重现等效的生产响应，而单井拟合结果之间却存在显著差异。当油田包含多种沉积环境和建模策略时，这种模糊性会进一步加剧。本文将图自编码器方法应用于包含不同沉积带的基准Brugge油田的历史拟合。每个地层层带均由其专用的生成模型进行建模，这些生成模型共享一个用于优化历史拟合循环的联合潜在空间。基于图的生成器直接作用于角点网格的活跃单元，因此无需将网格转换为规则网格即可处理其不规则的几何形状。在160维联合潜在空间中的优化搜索采用协方差矩阵自适应进化策略（CMA-ES）完成。多分量目标函数包括静态井数据不匹配（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种图生成模型集成方法，为Brugge油田的每个地层沉积带分别建立专用图自编码器，共享联合潜在空间并使用CMA-ES进化策略进行优化，直接在角点网格活跃单元上操作，从而实现对具有多种沉积环境油田的辅助历史拟合。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an ensemble of graph generative models, employing dedicated graph autoencoders for each stratigraphic zone of the Brugge field with CMA-ES optimization in a joint 160-dimensional latent space, enabling assisted history matching of fields with multiple depositional settings while directly handling irregular corner-point grid geometry.
